name: Zophar
summary: Zophar the Naamathite was one of Job's three friends, and he told Job that God was asking less of him than his sin deserved. The LORD later said the three friends had not spoken of Him what was right.

key_moments.title: Comes to Comfort Job
key_moments.description: Zophar came with Eliphaz and Bildad to mourn with Job and comfort him. When they saw him they wept and tore their robes, then sat with him seven days in silence.

key_moments.title: Tells Job He Deserves Worse
key_moments.description: Zophar called Job a man full of talk and wished God would speak against him. He told Job that God exacted of him less than his iniquity deserved.

key_moments.title: Rebuked by the LORD
key_moments.description: The LORD was angry with Eliphaz and his two friends, for they had not spoken rightly of Him as Job had. Zophar went with the others to offer a burnt offering as the LORD commanded, and the LORD accepted Job's prayer for them.
